newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissay says plans Y300 bln foreign bond investment.
newsitem.headline: Nissay says plans Y300 bln foreign bond investment.

text.p: Nippon Life Insurance Co (Nissay), Japan's largest life insurer, plans about 300 billion yen worth of fresh investment in foreign bonds in the 1997/98 fiscal year, provided that the yen/dollar exchange rate remains at around the current level, a senior executive of the company said on Wednesday.

"We invested around 600 billion to 650 billion yen in foreign bonds last fiscal year. If the dollar/yen remains at the current level of around 126 yen, we are likely to invest about 300 billion yen in foreign bonds this fiscal year," said Tadao Nishioka, the company's senior managing director. The 1997/98 fiscal year started on April 1.
"If the dollar falls below 120 yen and moves around that level, we may buy more foreign bonds. We may increase or decrease our foreign bond investments depending on the circumstances," he added.
